name: com.dementh.lib.battlenet_oauth2.activities.BnOAuthAccessTokenActivity
description: Dementhius's Battle.net OAuth2 library uses this Activity during sign-in; it shows Blizzard's authorization page, handles the HTTPS localhost callback, saves the returned access token, and opens the app's next screen.
disableEffect: Battle.net sign-in cannot finish because the app will not receive and save the authorization result.
